notes: two isnads carry the one saying, joined by «وأنبأنا» with no «ح»: two groups, no shared tail
the first isnad stops at عبد الرحمن بن القاسم; the saying is written after the second isnad, which ends at خنساء
«قال حدثني عبد الرحمن بن القاسم» after «عن مالك» is a new transmission, so the name stands twice (not merged)
«أبيه» is named only by relation; «ابنى يزيد بن جارية الأنصاري» is an appositive describing عبد الرحمن and مجمع, left out of the surfaces
«أن أباها زوجها» is the story's content, not a link
